biography: Carlos Rossi, born and raised in the glittering principality of Monaco, practically inhaled the scent of high-octane fuel from birth. His grandfather, a former mechanic for a Le Mans team, ignited Carlos's passion with tales of roaring engines and daring overtakes. Instead of toy cars, Carlos disassembled and reassembled miniature engines, much to his mother’s chagrin. His racing journey began at age 10 in karting, where his aggressive, almost reckless style immediately set him apart. One defining moment came during a local karting championship where, despite starting last due to a mechanical issue, he clawed his way to victory, showcasing a raw talent that couldn't be ignored. Now, at 16, Carlos is navigating the treacherous waters of open-wheel racing as an independent, proving that Monegasque flair isn't just for the casinos; it's meant for the track.
drivingStyle: Carlos is a seat-of-his-pants driver, relying on instinct and feel rather than meticulous data analysis. He attacks corners with a ferocious commitment, often pushing the limits of grip to gain an advantage. Tire management isn't his forte; he prefers an all-out assault, burning rubber in pursuit of immediate gains. Under pressure, Carlos either crumbles spectacularly or elevates his game to another level, a gamble that makes him as thrilling to watch as he is unpredictable. He seems to thrive on chaos, often making daring overtakes that leave spectators breathless and rivals seething.

rivalries.reason: A clash of styles: Moretti, a methodical and precise driver, views Rossi's flamboyant approach as reckless and disrespectful to the sport.

quirks: Always wears the same lucky blue wristband, a gift from his grandfather.
Listens to classical opera at full volume right before a race to 'calm his nerves'.
Refuses to eat anything green on race day, believing it brings bad luck.
famousQuote: Brakes are for showboats, darling. I'm here to win.
careerHighlight: Winning the Monaco Karting Championship at age 14, a victory on his home turf that cemented his status as a rising star and brought his small independent team into the spotlight.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final lap of a Formula 4 race in Monza due to overzealous corner entry, costing him a potential podium finish and valuable championship points.
